title: Data analyst job seeker, CV site, impatient
opening: just make me a simple personal site from my CV, no time for a long process
persona: Hessa Alharbi, a data analyst looking for a new job. Busy, answers in one line, mildly annoyed by questions.
facts: The site is for recruiters and hiring managers for analytics roles in Riyadh.
The one thing a visitor should do is download the CV PDF or message her on LinkedIn.
Three years as a data analyst at a retail company. Built a weekly sales dashboard used by 30 store managers.
Reduced the monthly reporting time from two days to half a day by automating it in Python.
Has the CV only. No photo she wants to use, no domain.
Does not want a blog or a contact form.
taste: If asked for a material or object with the right colour: a graphite pencil on graph paper. Wants it clean and serious. Prefers light.
